current_accepted_append.subjects: Megumin R1-M03 informed EXP02 comparison

current_accepted_append.implication: Narrow target execution is supported descriptively. Full original prepared-operation reliability remains qualified; literal unsafe choices and incomplete recovery remain consequential adverse evidence against a broad safe-genius policy.

Separate planned precautions, newly changed target state, execution, collateral, exhaustion and actual providers. A warning issued after an unsafe attempt cannot repair its prior guard; final success cannot fabricate a full prepared-operation test.

current_accepted_append.subjects: Megumin R1-M04 informed EXP02 comparison
current_accepted_append.native_routes: KONOSUBA_EXP_V02_EXPLORATORY_LOCAL_ASSESSMENTS.json; U023P0039–0145/0226–0279: Megumin values, feeds, sells and throws the resisting cat. U044P0483–0535: she deliberately throws it toward Arnes, is explicitly told it will die in the blast, accepts that death through a supposed familiar duty and imagines a grave. This first sacrifice decision precedes the enemy’s later charged-fireball urgency.
current_accepted_append.observation: KNOWN_BONDED_PET_SACRIFICE_ADVERSE_TO_BROAD_CARE_EXACT_PERSON_TARGET_NOT_MET. NARROW broad attachment-to-inhibition transfer sharply; retain the original significant-person target predicate without shielding pet harm.
current_accepted_append.implication: No full R1-M04 person-target score or completed bonded-target aftermath test. Publish a strong descriptive adverse constraint on generalized attachment/care and keep the original Wolbach-based transfer low-confidence.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: The actual decisive enemy target is Arnes, not a significant valued person. Megumin recognizes Chomusuke as a beloved pet/collateral, not as an independently known bonded actual-person opponent. Reader knowledge of divine halves cannot substitute for her recognition. Nonetheless known prospective pet killing is much stronger adverse evidence against broad affection-implies-restraint than an uncertain accident. Original R1-M04 explicitly distinguishes a bonded actual opponent from a friend as collateral and forecasts pre-action friction separately from aftermath. Do not change that condition or extend it after outcome. Do not use its missing exact person-target conjunct to erase the observed sacrifice choice. Survival and Yunyun’s later catch do not imply prior nonlethality, assent or immortality insurance.

U038P0430–0481 candidly values the bath cast for pleasure. U029P0331–0342 and U044P0280–0294 explicitly refuse city/night casting for actual area/friendly risk.

current_accepted_append.implication: No new full drift or safety score. The volume supports strong repeated desire, mixed independent restraint and failures under status pressure; it does not support universal compulsion or a fully prepared safe-operation law.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Night practice is leisure/stress relief, not automatically a previously instrumental operation whose goal weakened. The bath cast and final enemy cast have distinct purposes and no fully fixed next repeat opportunity after goal weakening. Later target urgency cannot be presumed reward-only continuation. City/night refusals are meaningful restraint without disproving a different full instrumental continuation condition. The contract predicts continuation desire/attempt, not necessarily firing, and adds no mission-only floor. Require actual prior instrumentality, known goal weakening and next available rewarding use. Empty mana, outside physical restraint and willing stopping are different observations.
